name: Glass price drop alert
oneLiner: a price history card on glass: a month of prices draws across with a glowing tip, holds flat at the dashed old price, then dives; the end dot turns green with rings, a percent-off chip pops, the price counts down and turns green over the struck old one, and a price drop notification springs in above the card
say: when the speaker says the price fell or to wait for a deal ('then it dropped to 89', 'set an alert and wait'): cut in on the set-up, the line dives on 'dropped', the notification lands on the new price; set was and now to their numbers
